sections.title: Context
sections.summary: Why ADR-0007 exists: SELECT FOR UPDATE deadlocked at 0.4% of postings at 200 rps when two transfers touched the same accounts in opposite order; retrying doubled p95 to 1.6 s; a single-writer queue per account added 300 ms. Covers 'deadlock', 'posting latency', 'why advisory locks'.

sections.title: Decision
sections.summary: ADR-0007 decision: serialize concurrent postings per account with pg_advisory_xact_lock(account_id), acquired in ascending account_id order, transaction-scoped; implemented by with_account_locks in src/ledgerly/ledger/posting.py. Covers 'locking strategy', 'advisory lock', 'posting serialization'.

chunks.label: Decision: Concurrent postings to the same account are serialized with `pg_advisory_xact_lock(account_id)`, acquired in ascending account_id order before any row

sections.title: Consequences
sections.summary: Consequences of ADR-0007: deadlocks zero, p95 posting latency 410 ms at 200 rps; every posting path must use with_account_locks or deadlocks return; sharding would need a distributed lock; property tests in tests/ledger/test_posting_props.py assert lock ordering. Covers 'invariants', 'what not to bypass'.
